title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.19068v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry. translated_title: 先规划还是先检索？工具发现架构的规模化研究
translated_abstract: 工具增强的大语言模型（LLM）智能体在规划执行前需要从大型注册表中发现相关API，然而有限的上下文窗口无法将所有工具定义注入单个提示词中。主流方法——我们称之为“先检索后规划”（Retrieve-then-Plan, RtP）——通过嵌入用户查询并利用近似最近邻搜索来检索相似工具。我们研究了另一种“先规划后检索”（Plan-then-Retrieve, PtR）范式，其中LLM首先生成抽象工具桩（描述所需能力的假设函数签名），然后将其作为针对注册表的检索查询。我们在ToolBench（包含46,984个唯一API端点、50个类别）上，对单工具（G1）、类别内多工具（G2）和跨类别多工具（G3）查询子集进行了评估，发现存在一个清晰的随复杂度变化的交叉现象：RtP在单工具查询上优于PtR，而PtR在多工具查询上优于RtP。这一交叉现象在所有检索预算（k=1至……）下均成立。
tldr: 该研究系统比较了工具发现中“先检索后规划”与“先规划后检索”两种架构，首次揭示了随任务复杂度变化的交叉规律：单工具查询时先检索更优，多工具查询时先规划更佳。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP) and Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) architectures for tool discovery, revealing a complexity-dependent crossover: RtP excels on single-tool queries while PtR outperforms on multi-tool queries.
